rows.en: • Section 2 does not have any icons next to it because these activities relate to internal organizational processes and don’t require inter-sectoral coordination. These activities are here to guide organizations internal work and systems as they are crucial for the planning and implementation of a safe and effective MHPSS response.
rows.ne: • खण्ड 2 को छेउमा कुनै चिह्नहरू छैनन् किनभने यी गतिविधिहरू संस्थाका आन्तरिक प्रक्रियासँग सम्बन्धित छन् र यिनका लागि अन्तरक्षेत्रीय समन्वय आवश्यक पर्दैन। यी गतिविधिहरू संस्थाहरूको आन्तरिक काम र प्रणालीलाई मार्गदर्शन गर्न यहाँ राखिएका हुन्, किनकि सुरक्षित र प्रभावकारी MHPSS प्रतिकार्यको योजना र कार्यान्वयनका लागि ती अत्यन्त महत्त्वपूर्ण छन्।
rows.bt: • There are no symbols beside Section 2 because these activities relate to an organization's internal processes and do not require intersectoral coordination. These activities have been placed here to guide organizations' internal work and systems, because they are extremely important for planning and implementing a safe and effective MHPSS response.
rows.note: The supplied source note reports that this passage lies outside the visible page boundary, so its inclusion and placement remain unconfirmed.

rows.en: » Underscore that organizations must have sound systems for program design, for coordination, for M&E, for caring for staff & volunteers and for building the MHPSS competencies of staff & volunteers. Section 2 refers to the activities that any organizations engaging in any type of MHPSS activity should be doing.
rows.ne: » कार्यक्रमको रूपरेखा तयार गर्न, समन्वय गर्न, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) गर्न, कर्मचारी तथा स्वयंसेवकहरूको हेरचाह गर्न र कर्मचारी तथा स्वयंसेवकहरूको MHPSS सम्बन्धी सक्षमता विकास गर्न संस्थाहरूसँग सुदृढ प्रणालीहरू हुनैपर्छ भन्ने कुरामा जोड दिनुहोस्। खण्ड 2 ले कुनै पनि प्रकारको MHPSS गतिविधिमा संलग्न कुनै पनि संस्थाले गर्नुपर्ने अपेक्षा गरिएका गतिविधिहरू जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: » Emphasize that organizations must have strong systems to prepare the programme outline, coordinate, carry out monitoring and evaluation (M&E), care for staff and volunteers, and develop staff and volunteers' MHPSS-related competence. Section 2 indicates the activities that any organization involved in any type of MHPSS activity is expected to carry out.
rows.note: The supplied source note reports that this passage lies outside the visible page boundary; the draft distinguishes mandatory systems from activities organizations are expected to undertake.

rows.en: Emphasize that the purpose of this exercise is getting familiar with the MSP and learning how to navigate it so more tech savvy participants can help less tech savvy participants to learn to navigate the platform if needed.
rows.ne: यस अभ्यासको उद्देश्य MSP सँग परिचित हुनु र यसमा आवश्यक जानकारी कसरी खोज्ने तथा विभिन्न भागमा कसरी जाने भन्ने सिक्नु हो भन्ने कुरामा जोड दिनुहोस्, ताकि आवश्यक परेमा प्रविधि प्रयोगमा बढी दक्ष सहभागीहरूले कम दक्ष सहभागीहरूलाई मञ्चमा आवश्यक जानकारी कसरी खोज्ने तथा विभिन्न भागमा कसरी जाने भन्ने सिक्न सहयोग गर्न सकून्।
rows.bt: Emphasize that the purpose of this exercise is to become familiar with MSP and to learn how to find the necessary information in it and how to go to different sections, so that, if necessary, participants who are more proficient in using technology can help less proficient participants learn how to find the necessary information on the platform and how to go to different sections.
rows.note: Uses [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] as a contextual shortened form of the proposed term for online platform; glossary review pending. The final clause broadens learning to navigate the platform into learning to use it generally. The revision restores the specific navigation focus of the assistance.

rows.ne: स्लाइडहरू प्रयोग गरी र आवश्यक पर्दा वेबसाइट तथा PDF पनि प्रयोग गरी प्रत्येक उत्तर कहाँ फेला पर्छ भनेर देखाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Show where each answer is found using the slides and, when needed, also using the website and PDF.

rows.ne: समय दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Give time.
rows.note: The object of 'Give' is supplied by the following row; the heading refers to allowing time.

rows.en: the groups a minute to count up the final score.
rows.ne: अन्तिम अङ्क जोड्न समूहहरूलाई एक मिनेट दिनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Give the groups one minute to add up the final scores.
rows.note: The preceding heading's verb is repeated to make its continuation a complete Nepali instruction.

rows.en: Celebrate the winning team and everyone´s work.
rows.ne: विजयी टोलीको जित र सबैले गरेको कामको खुसी मनाउनुहोस्।
rows.bt: Celebrate the winning team’s victory and the work everyone has done.

rows.ne: उदाहरण दिन भन्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Ask for examples.
rows.note: The following row establishes that 'Ask' means requesting examples rather than posing a question.

rows.en: participants to give some examples from their own context of both positive and negative interactions (e.g., how being part of a religious community may positively impact a person’s feelings, how being exposed to racism or misogyny may negatively impact a person’s feelings).
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूलाई आफ्नै सन्दर्भबाट सकारात्मक र नकारात्मक दुवै किसिमका अन्तरक्रियाका केही उदाहरण दिन भन्नुहोस् (जस्तै, धार्मिक समुदायको हिस्सा हुँदा व्यक्तिको भावनामा कसरी सकारात्मक प्रभाव पर्न सक्छ, नस्लवाद वा महिलाप्रति द्वेषको सामना गर्नुपर्दा व्यक्तिको भावनामा कसरी नकारात्मक प्रभाव पर्न सक्छ)।
rows.bt: Ask participants to give some examples of both positive and negative kinds of interactions from their own contexts (for example, how being part of a religious community can have a positive effect on a person’s feelings, how having to face racism or hatred toward women can have a negative effect on a person’s feelings).
rows.note: The preceding heading's request is repeated to make its continuation a complete Nepali instruction. Feelings and interactions are used here in their ordinary, nonclinical senses.

rows.ne: अनलाइन सहजीकरण
rows.bt: Online facilitation

rows.en: It is likely that participants will primarily use the online platform.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूले मुख्य रूपमा अनलाइन मञ्च प्रयोग गर्ने सम्भावना छ।
rows.bt: Participants are likely to mainly use the online platform.
rows.note: Uses the proposed term for online platform; glossary review pending.

rows.en: Encourage participants to also use the PDF so they also become familiar with it.
rows.ne: सहभागीहरूलाई PDF सँग पनि परिचित हुनका लागि त्यसको समेत प्रयोग गर्न प्रोत्साहन गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Encourage participants to use the PDF as well so that they also become familiar with it.
